description: This file defines a JavaScript class 'DeviceListApp' that manages device listing and connection UI for a WebRTC operator frontend. It includes methods for fetching device IDs, updating the UI, and handling user interactions, along with initialization code that creates an instance of the class and starts it on page load.

classes.name: DeviceListApp
classes.description: A class that manages the device list UI, fetches device IDs from a server, and handles user interactions to connect to devices.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the DeviceListApp with a URL for device fetching and a callback for device selection.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the device list update process and sets up the refresh button event listener.

methods.name: #UpdateDeviceList
methods.description: Fetches the list of device IDs from the server and updates the UI.

methods.name: #ShowNewDeviceList
methods.description: Updates the DOM with the new list of devices and attaches event handlers to connect buttons.

methods.name: #createDeviceEntry
methods.description: Creates a DOM element representing a device entry with a connect button.
